name: jtasks
description: Project tasks, progress and recorded logs, with an automatically provisioned native CLI.

settings.title: Trusted update repository
settings.description: GitHub owner/repo that publishes complete jtasks releases. Empty disables online updates.

settings.title: Check for updates automatically
settings.description: Checks stable releases at most once per day when the panel opens. Installation requires the Update button; Orca may request approval for new access.

settings.title: Native executable override
settings.description: Optional absolute path to a compatible native jtasks executable. Otherwise provisioned automatically.

settings.title: Make jtasks available to new local agents
settings.description: Adds the CLI directory to new local agent environments. Existing terminals and global PATH are unchanged.
